newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: OVER 60 PCT OF HERMIS SHARE ISSUE SOLD.
newsitem.headline: OVER 60 PCT OF HERMIS SHARE ISSUE SOLD.

text.p: Lithuania's Hermis Bank, the country's second largest private bank, said on Monday that its current shareholders had bought over 60 percent of its new 23 million litas share issue.
Liudmila Kirkiliene, the head of the bank's securities department, told Reuters that all major shareholders except for the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development subscribed to the issue.
She added that the first stage of the share offering, which gave present shareholders priority rights, was now complete.
"The board of the bank will now decide how the rest of the shares will be distributed over the next 30 days," Kirkiliene said.
Kirkiliene also said that the prospectus of the share issue allowed it to be distributed publicly or in a closed manner.
The bank said earlier that it was mulling the possibility of selling the rest of the shares abroad.
The share issue will increase the bank's share capital to 90 million litas.
